articles.heading: Umunyamabanga Mukuru ashobora gusaba Akanama gashinzwe Umutekano kwita ku kibazo icyo ari cyo cyose abona ko gishobora
articles.text:
guhungabanya amahoro n’umutekano
mpuzamahanga.

articles.heading: Mu kuzuza inshingano zabo, Umunyamabanga Mukuru n’abakozi ntibasaba cyangwa ngo bahabwe amabwiriza na leta iyo ari yo yose
articles.text:
cyangwa urundi rwego urwo ari rwo rwose rutari
urw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye. Birinda igikorwa
icyo ari cyo cyose cyabangamira imyanya barimo
nk’abakozi mpuzamahanga bayoborwa gusa
n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye.
Buri munyamuryango w’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye yiyemeje guha agaciro imiterere
mpuzamahanga y’inshingano z’Umunyamabanga
Mukuru n’iz’abakozi no kutivanga mu iyuzuzwa
ry’inshingano zabo.

articles.heading: Abakozi bashyirwaho n’Umunyamabanga Mukuru ashingiye ku mabwiriza ashyirwaho n'Inteko Rusange
articles.text:
Abakozi bakwiye bashyirwa mu myanya mu buryo
buhoraho mu Kanama gashinzwe Ubukungu
n’Imibereho myiza, mu Kanama gashinzwe
Ubwishingire no mu zindi nzego z’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye. Aba bakozi ni bamwe mu bagize
Ubunyamabanga.
Mu gushaka abakozi no kugena uburyo bakoramo,
ikitabwaho cy’ingenzi ni ibipimo ngenderwaho
byo hejuru mu gukora neza, mu bushobozi
n’ubunyangamugayo. Hitabwa kandi ku gaciro
gahabwa ishakwa ry’abakozi rishingiye ku
iringaniza ry’ibyerekezo by'isi mu buryo
bushoboka bwose.
UMUTWE WA XVI : INGINGO
ZINYURANYE

articles.heading: Amasezerano mpuzamahanga ayo ari yo yose akorwa n’umunyamuryango w’Umuryango w’Abibumbye nyuma y’uko aya Masezerano
articles.text:
atangira gukurikizwa ahita yandikishwa mu
Bunyamabanga kandi bukayatangaza.
Nta ruhande na rumwe ruri mu masezeramo
mpuzamahanga azaba atandikishijwe hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa mu gika cya mbere cy’iyi ngingo,
rwashobora kuyashingiraho imbere y’Urwego
urwo ari rwo rwose rw’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye.

articles.heading: Mu gihe habayeho kugongana kw’inshingano abanyamuryango b’Umuryango w’Abibumbye bafite muri aya Masezerano n’izo bafite mu yandi
articles.text:
masezeramo mpuzamahanga ayo ari yo yose, izo
bafite muri aya Masezerano zisumba izindi.

articles.heading: Umuryango w’Abibumbye ufite ububasha bwa ngombwa muri buri gihugu mu biwugize kugira ngo wuzuze inshingano kandi ugere ku ntego zawo
Umuryango w’Abibumbye ufite uburenganzira bwihariye n’ubudahangarwa bya ngombwa muri buri gihugu mu biwugize kugira ngo ugere ku
articles.text:
ntego zawo.
Abahagarariye abanyamuryango b’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye n’abakozi bawo bose bagira
uburenganzira bwihariye n’ubudahangarwa bya
ngombwa kugira ngo buzuze mu bwigenege
inshingano zabo zirebana n’Umuryango.
Inteko Rusange ishobora gutanga inama mu
kugena uburyo bwo gushyira mu bikorwa
ibiteganyijwe mu gika cya mbere n’icya 2 by'iyi
ngingo cyangwa igatangiza amasezerano
mpuzamahanga hagati y’abanyamuryango
b’Umuryango w’Abibumbye kugira ngo
bigerweho.
UMUTWE WA XVII : INGINGO
Z'INZIBACYUHO ZEREKEYE
UMUTEKANO

articles.heading: Mu gihe amasezerano yihariye ateganywa n’ingingo ya 43 ataratangira gukurikizwa ku buryo Akanama gashinzwe Umutekano kabona ko
articles.text:
katangira kuzuza inshingano zako ziteganywa mu
ngingo ya 42, abashyiriye umukono kw’Itangazo
ry’ibihugu bine i Moscow ku wa 30 Ukwakira
1943 n’Ubufaransa bakurikije igika cya 5 cy’iryo
Tangazo bazajya bungurana inama kandi, igihe
bibaye ngombwa, bajye inama n’abandi
banyamuryango b’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ku
buryo bwo guhuza ibikorwa mu izina
ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye hagamijwe
kubumbatira amahoro n’umutekano
mpuzamahanga.

articles.heading: Nta giteganyijwe muri aya Masezerano gitesha agaciro cyangwa kibuza igikorwa kireba igihugu
articles.text:
icyo ari cyo cyose cyabaye mu gihe cy’intambara
ya II y’isi, umwanzi w’ighugu icyo ari cyo cyose
cyashyize umukono kuri aya Masezerano
cyafashwe cyangwa cyemewe nk’ingaruka z’iyo
ntambara na za Leta zifite inshingano kuri icyo
gikorwa.
UMUTWE WA XVIII : IVUGURURWA

articles.heading: Amavugururwa y’aya Masezerano atangira gukurikizwa ku banyamuryango b’Umuryango w’Abibumbye bose iyo yatowe na bibiri bya gatatu
articles.text:
by'abagize Inteko Rusange kandi akemezwa
burundu na bibiri bya gatatu by’abanyamuryango
b’Umuryango w’Abibumbye harimo abagize
Akanama gashinzwe Umutekano bahoraho
hakurikijwe inzira ziteganywa n’amategeko
nshinga yabyo.

articles.heading: Inama rusange y’abanyamuryango b’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ku ivugururwa ry’aya Masezerano ishobora guterana ku itariki n’ahantu byemejwe
articles.text:
mu itora ry’Inteko Rusange ku bwiganze bwa
bibiri bya gatatu n’itora ry’abanyamurango
icyenda abo ari bo bose mu bagize Akanama
gashinzwe Umutekano. Buri munyamuryango
w’Umuryango w’Abibumbye agira ijwi rimwe
muri iyi nama.
Ihinduka iryo ari ryo ryose ry’aya Masezerano
ryifujwe na bibiri bya gatatu by’abagize inama
rigira agaciro iyo ryemejwe burundu na bibiri bya
gatatu by’abanyamuryango b’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye harimo n’abagize Akanama
gashinzwe Umutekano bahoraho bose binyuze mu
nzira ziteganywa n’amategeko nshinga yabyo.
Mu gihe iyo nama idateranye mbere y’inama
ngarukamwaka ya cumi y’Inteko Rusange
ikurikira igihe aya Masezerano yatangiriye
gukurikizwa, gahunda yo kuyitumiza ishyirwa ku
murongo w’ibyigirwa mu nama y’Inteko Rusange;
hanyuma iyo nama igaterana ari uko byemejwe
n’ubwiganze bw’amajwi y’abagize Inteko
Rusange n’aya barindwi mu bo ari bo bose bagize
Akanama gashinzwe Umutekano.
UMUTWE WA XIX : KUYEMEZA
BURUNDU NO KUYASHYIRAHO
UMUKONO

articles.heading: Aya Masezerano yemezwa burundu n’ibihugu byayashyizeho umukono binyuze mu nzira ziteganywa n’amategeko nshinga yabyo
articles.text:
Inyandiko ziyemeza burundu zishyikirizwa
Guverinoma ya Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika
na yo ikazimenyesha ibihugu byose
byayashyizeho umukono n’Umunyamabanga
Mukuru w’Umuryango w’Abibimbye mu gihe
azaba yashyizweho.
Aya Masezerano atangira gukurikizwa igihe
Repubulika y’Ubushinwa, Ubufaransa,
Repubulika zunze ubumwe z’Abasoviyeti,
Ubwami bw’Ubwongereza na Leta Zunze
ubumwe za Amerika n’ubwiganze bw’ibindi
bihugu byayashyizeho umukono bitanze
inyandiko zabyo ziyemeza burundu. Inyandiko
mvugo y’itangwa ry’inyandiko zemeza burundu
aya Masezerano ikorwa na Guverinoma ya Leta
zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika na yo igaha kopi
ibihugu byose byayashyizeho umukono.
Ibihugu byashyize umukono kuri aya Masezerano
bikayemeza burundu nyuma y’uko atangira
gukurikizwa bihinduka abanyamuryango shingiro
b’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ku munsi inyandiko
zabyo ziyemeza burundu zitangiweho.

articles.heading: Aya Masezerano ari mu nyandiko z’umwimerere zifite agaciro kangana zanditswe mu Igishinwa, Igifaransa, Ikirusiya, Icyongereza n’Icyesipanyolo
articles.text:
ashyirwa mu ishyinguranyandiko rya Guverinoma
ya Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Iyo
Guverinoma yoherereza inyandukuro zihuje
n’umwimerere z’ayo Masezerano guverinoma
z’ibindi bihugu byayashyizeho umukono.
BAMAZE KWEMERA IBIKUBIYE MURI AYA
MASEZERANO, abahagarariye Guverinoma
z’ibihugu bigize Umuryango w’Abibumbye
bayashyizeho umukono.
BIKOREWE mu mujyi wa San Francisco ku wa
makumyabiri na gatandatu Kamena, mu gihumbi
na magana cyenda na mirongo ine na gatanu.
